ai_modifiers.sql: SELECT m.*,a.Name,a.Value FROM Modifiers m LEFT JOIN ModifierArguments a USING(ModifierId) WHERE (m.ModifierId GLOB 'COREX*_AI_*' OR m.ModifierId GLOB 'RURCOM*_AI_*') ORDER BY m.ModifierId,a.Name

ai_district_preferences.sql: SELECT l.ListType,l.LeaderType,l.System,a.Item,a.Favored,a.Value FROM AiLists l JOIN AiFavoredItems a USING(ListType) WHERE l.System='Districts' AND(a.Item GLOB 'DISTRICT_CORE*'OR a.Item GLOB 'DISTRICT_RURALCOMMUNITY*') ORDER BY l.ListType,a.Item

ai_building_lists.sql: SELECT l.ListType,l.LeaderType,l.System,count(*) items FROM AiLists l JOIN AiFavoredItems a USING(ListType)WHERE l.ListType GLOB 'CL_MajorCivs*'AND l.System='Buildings' GROUP BY l.ListType,l.LeaderType,l.System

ai_trait_counts.sql: SELECT TraitType,count(*) leaders FROM LeaderTraits WHERE TraitType GLOB 'TRAIT_CL_MAJOR_CIV*'GROUP BY TraitType

trait_attachments.sql: SELECT * FROM TraitModifiers WHERE TraitType GLOB 'TRAIT_CL_MAJOR_CIV*' ORDER BY TraitType,ModifierId

district_ai_attachments.sql: SELECT * FROM DistrictModifiers WHERE ModifierId GLOB 'COREX*_AI_*'OR ModifierId GLOB 'RURCOM*_AI_*'ORDER BY DistrictType,ModifierId

civic_ai_attachments.sql: SELECT * FROM CivicModifiers WHERE ModifierId GLOB 'COREX*_AI_*' ORDER BY CivicType,ModifierId

urban_generic_adjacency.sql: SELECT d.DistrictType,a.* FROM District_Adjacencies d JOIN Adjacency_YieldChanges a ON a.ID=d.YieldChangeId WHERE d.DistrictType IN('DISTRICT_COREEXPANSIONA','DISTRICT_COREEXPANSIONB','DISTRICT_COREEXPANSIONC')AND a.OtherDistrictAdjacent=1

rural_outward_negative_adjacency.sql: SELECT d.DistrictType,a.ID,a.YieldType,a.YieldChange,a.AdjacentDistrict FROM District_Adjacencies d JOIN Adjacency_YieldChanges a ON a.ID=d.YieldChangeId WHERE a.AdjacentDistrict IN('DISTRICT_RURALCOMMUNITYA','DISTRICT_RURALCOMMUNITYB','DISTRICT_RURALCOMMUNITYC')AND a.YieldChange<0 ORDER BY d.DistrictType,a.AdjacentDistrict

exclusions.sql: SELECT * FROM MutuallyExclusiveDistricts WHERE District GLOB 'DISTRICT_COREEXPANSION*'OR District GLOB 'DISTRICT_RURALCOMMUNITY*'

ai_requirements.sql: SELECT s.RequirementSetId,r.RequirementId,r.RequirementType,r.Inverse,a.Name,a.Value FROM RequirementSetRequirements s JOIN Requirements r USING(RequirementId)LEFT JOIN RequirementArguments a USING(RequirementId)WHERE s.RequirementSetId IN('PLAYER_IS_AI','PLAYER_IS_HUMAN','COREXA_AI_SET_HAS_TIER1_CUL')
